goal: Use the authority token only in a clean protected-main preflight before pull-request code runs, with an exact single-use regression guard and bounded quota wait.
dispatcher: Codex parent session for non-orchestrator issue 3361
prohibited_actions: Do not alter database objects or settings
Do not run a pull-request script with AUTHORITY_TOKEN
Do not reveal the token value
assumptions: The existing preflight module resolves relative imports from its file location; its cwd-dependent mirror and pin reads use origin/main. The trusted checkout is verified clean and at current origin/main before the token is supplied to the script.
stop_conditions: Stop if a guarded review or required check refuses
Stop if the trusted checkout cannot be proved current and clean
